prompt: Write 20 short statement starters for a two-truths-and-a-lie family game, for example 'A place I have been...'. Each should help a shy player (age 8 to 80) think of a true statement and a plausible lie. Family-safe and original.
output:
Here are 20 gentle, easy starters — perfect for shy players. Just finish the sentence with 2 real answers and 1 made-up answer:

1. A food I have tasted...
2. Something I can make or cook...
3. A game I like to play...
4. A song I know the words to...
5. An animal I have seen up close...
6. Something I am good at...
7. A place near home I like to go...
8. Something I found outside...
9. Something I lost and then found...
10. A holiday memory I have...
11. Something kind I did for someone...
12. A book or movie I love...
13. Something I once collected...
14. A skill I learned from family...
15. Something funny that happened to me...
16. A smell I really like...
17. Something I helped fix...
18. A dream I remember...
19. A job I would like to try for one day...
20. Something I made with my hands...
